notes.title: Changelog v0.8.3
notes.notes:
[list]

notes.title: Changelog
notes.notes:
This upgrade includes major changes, as the game is upgraded to 64-bit now.
Overall performance should increase, and you should encounter fewer, if any, crashes from memory errors.
Please note, there might be some issues with loading some of your save files with this patch, but hopefully, everything will work without any issues.
If you encounter an error when loading a save, try clicking ignore or rollback a few times.

[list]
[*] Upgraded Ren'Py version to 7.4.10
[*] Prepared Season 1 for the upcoming DLC
[*] Fixed deprecated functionality and fixed bugs due to the Ren'Py upgrade.
[*] Updated functionality for viewing special renders in the Rewards app.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Rewards app, showing an exclamation mark wrongly when reloading saves after finding special renders.
[*] Fixed a rare bug where the app description would still show after closing the phone.
[*] Fixed a bug with the new message icon in episode 2.
[*] Fixed a dialogue issue for Isabella's morning scene in episode 2.
[*] Fixed a dialogue bug with gender classes episodes 1-2.
[*] Redesigned the game menus
[*] Added a button to manually save persistent data in the Save menu; automatic saving still works as before.
[*] Fixed a bug where opening the vault unlocked vaults from other episodes.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could buy mini-game-related cheats from Derek when not playing mini-games in episode 1.
[*] Fixed a rare bug with Brawler that caused four options that resulted in a miss to show at once.
[*] Fixed a bug with the math tests that displayed the wrong grade when cheating.
[*] Corrected typos
[*] Updated the format of the guide. It should be easier to read than before.
[*] Added a Guide button to the quick menu of the game. You can access the guide using this button or the 'g' key as usual.
[/list]

notes.title: Being a DIK - Season 1: Patch notes
notes.notes:
Today a patch launched for Being a DIK - Season 1.
I don't want to update the game too often since there's a risk that some old saves become incompatible with every patch.
That's sadly how the RenPy engine works with save files. I hope that too many aren't affected by this and if you experience any issue loading an old save, try clicking Ignore or Rollback a few times and see if it pops back into gear.

This patch brings fixes and improvements to the game. The most noteworthy fix is that the Gallery counter, which in some cases made players miss the gallery achievement, has been fixed.

Let me know in the discussion forum if you need any assistance.

On a further note, the development of Season 2 is approximately [b]25% completed[/b].
A huge thanks for your support!

Best regards
Dr PinkCake

notes.title: Patch notes, February 16, 2020
notes.notes:
Thank you all for reporting bugs to me. I'm monitoring the threads and trying to fix everything that gets reported. This is a list of bugs that I have fixed since release.
Restart Steam and you should get an update with the latest changes.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in episode 1 where the chat with Josy wouldn't trigger a dialogue prompt during the date in certain cases.
[*] Adjusted the difficulty setting for Brawler. It should feel easier to play Brawler on Easy/Normal. Hard difficulty setting will feel slightly easier.
[*] Two animations were added to a lewd scene (episode 4).
[*] Fixed a bug that caused cheating to fail on the English test in episode 4.
[*] Fixed a cosmetic bug with Brawler with text messages after winning a fight multiple times and getting no reward.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash at the Save/Load screen if special characters were used to comment the save.
[*] Corrected typos
[/list]

If you encounter any issues with the game, please try verifying your game cache as the first step. Sometimes your download is corrupt and may be missing files.

Use the following steps to see if your game files are valid or not:
Right-click the game in the library and select properties.
Click Local files > Verify integrity of game cache
Wait until the process is complete and Steam will download any missing files.

Thank you all for your support! And please, continue to report any bugs you find and I will try my utmost to assist you.

Best regards
Dr PinkCake

notes.title: Being a DIK: Season 1 release
notes.notes:
After working hard on the Steam build for Being a DIK: Season 1, I can now announce that the release date on Steam will be Valentine's day, February 14th, for PC and Linux systems.

Due to Apple's new forced notarization policy, a macOS version won't be supported on Steam, for now.

Add the game to your watchlist and you'll get a message when it's released.

Cheers
Dr PinkCake
